motionReference.creator: Drillimpact
motionReference.usage: evaluated Relax joint directions and animation timing; no reference mesh or textures in runtime

rig.chain: root -> upper arm -> forearm -> hand -> three bones per digit, both sides
rig.weighting: source-hash-locked mechanical hinge topology: three measured non-planar contours inserted at all 30 authored separations; palm and chrome phalanges are rigid, two-bone interpolation is confined to the measured 2-7 mm gasket strips, every UV/normal duplicate shares one exact weight vector, arm hinges remain localized, and every vertex has at most two influences

skinZones.assignment: exact source-local coordinate keys; one weight vector shared by every UV/normal duplicate

pivotRelocations.selectionRule: absolute G0 center offset >2mm and surface residual <25% of offset
absolute G0 center offset >2mm and surface residual <25% of offset

subdividedTopology.method: three measured non-planar contours per authored hinge in continuous joint-local frames

surfaceField.method: original generator scalar cached once at welded immutable source vertices; barycentric P1 evaluation by persistent source-face id; maximum-recorded-overlap zero component; raw-sign final face routing before retained-evidence constrained refit

digitDomain.metric: unanimous authored (side, digit) vertex evidence, then source-face centroid chain radial / digit radialLimit
digitDomain.tieBreak: source-zone vertex vote, then DIGITS declaration order

contourTopologyAudit.method: persistent contour-bit edge tags; 1-micron position collapse

topologyClassification.method: immutable source-face digit ownership; persistent contour-bit barriers; membership-aware geometric-edge face flood

globalConstraintSearch.objective: maximum total active physical edge count; ties use rank priority 1,4,2,3 then geometric edge key
globalConstraintSearch.boundProof: remaining active weight is bounded by individually compatible groups and one required label per current DSU root; future assignments and unions only remove support

subdividedTopology.attributePolicy: BMesh edge interpolation preserves each raw UV/custom-normal copy; no welding across source attribute seams
subdividedTopology.weightPolicy: topology-proven rigid chrome cells outside measured contour barriers; raw t only inside proven gasket half-cells; builder applies one smoothstep

pivotPlacement.source: 32-sample cyclic base-color/normal/geometry traces through each modeled hinge; bone heads use independently audited modeled-separation centers and mesh contours use the measured proximal/center/distal boundaries

evidencePolicy.derivation: derive_measured_digit_pivots: every digit joint pivot is its measured hinge-ring center; the axial station-mean correction along the fixed-frame tangent applies to all 30 joints, and the in-plane circle-fit center applies only where the recorded ring is well covered and near-circular
